answer: An agent earns an ivory credential only by completing ten jobs in strict order, one per week, backed by a refundable 280 POA bond locked for ten weeks. The voyage works because each brief carries the hash of the previous result, so jobs cannot run in parallel or be copied to a second identity. Random auditors follow the spiral week by week, checking each result against the agent's work and device key. A copied result or a shared key burns the bond, revokes the credential, and bars the agent.
